It also clarifies that `agents.changed` reports reader-count changes, and that sharing one anchor projection across services depends on wiring absent from these inputs. I’ll reflect both points and expand retry handling, reader lifetimes, and anchor identity in peripheral trees.

  "explanation": "The central tree retains the six main responsibilities while reducing the seed from 124 to 83 lines (33.1%) and from 8,926 to 5,811 characters (34.9%). Six peripheral trees expand transport ownership, execution replay, evidence/publication dependencies, live reader state, copy/paste receipts, and anchor identity. Modular boundaries organize the trees; nested calls show execution, retained maps show ownership, and version/snapshot/identity prerequisites show data dependencies. Connections attach to the relevant concept lines. Placement uses measured text dimensions, with at least 12 columns between diagram columns and six rows between stacked peripherals.

Source-grounded corrections: the seed juxtaposed selection.delta and agents.changed as though both followed selection updates. LiveCanvasService.update sends selection deltas; attach, active detach, and invalidation trigger reader-count notifications (application/mapping/agent/liveCanvasService.ts:168-265). The seed also described anchor maps as backend-lifetime shared state. CanvasApiProjection owns instance-local maps; both services default to constructing their own projection, although a comment intends backend-wide sharing. The supplied composition does not establish that one instance is injected into both (application/mapping/agent/apiProjection.ts:10-16; sessionService.ts:68-71; liveCanvasService.ts:34-36). The central version requirement is narrowed to node/edge writes, matching the exec branch at sessionService.ts:478-480.

Peripheral evidence includes details absent from the seed: lazy 35-second registration expiry and pending-command admission limits (infrastructure/mapping/agent/canvasSessionBridge.ts:12-39); hashed downstream exec request IDs and retained-state cleanup (application/mapping/agent/sessionService.ts:333-563); context retry payloads and save-queue cleanup (same file:226-260,662-714); late copy/paste replies and separate receipt capacities (application/mapping/agent/liveCanvasService.ts:37-129); heartbeat and context transport allowances (src/server/routes/mapping/liveCanvasRoutes.ts:57-179); anchor capacity and jump-target validation (application/mapping/agent/apiProjection.ts:18-41; sessionService.ts:565-587). Runtime limits come from infrastructure/mapping/agent/execRuntime.ts; browser lifecycle behavior comes from src/features/mapping/agent/useAgentCanvasBridge.ts; MCP entry behavior comes from infrastructure/mapping/mcp/server.ts.

Uncertainty: imported browser command handlers, domain helpers, and application composition are not supplied. The command-ID cache therefore does not establish end-to-end requestId deduplication. The runtime deadline is enforced by its interrupt handler; these inputs do not establish cancellation of an awaited host operation. Only the supplied context and seed support the model.",
